core_facts.fact: Between **1971 and 1974** at Harvard, a young **Robert Trivers** published three papers that transformed behavioral science forever: **Reciprocal Altruism (*Quarterly Review of Biology*, 1971, SRC1)**, **Parental Investment and Sexual Selection (1972)**, and **Parent-Offspring Conflict (*American Zoologist*, 1974, SRC2)**.

In **1971 (SRC1)**, Trivers solved Darwin's puzzle of why unrelated strangers ever help each other — from **coral-reef cleaner wrasses** swimming safely inside giant grouper jaws to humans rescuing or sharing food: whenever **Benefit to Receiver > Cost to Donor** AND individuals meet repeatedly with memory, natural selection wires up **gratitude, sympathy, moralistic anger at cheaters, and reparative guilt**.

In **1972**, Trivers explained the mystery behind **Darwin's Sexual Selection** (why peacocks grow extravagant tails while peahens inspect carefully): it is **NOT 'maleness' or 'femaleness' per se** — it is **Relative Parental Investment** (any investment in one offspring that reduces the parent's capacity to invest in other offspring).

Across mammals (9 months internal gestation + lactation vs minutes), females bear a **vastly higher minimum obligatory investment** — predicting the high-investing sex will be **more selective about mate quality/commitment**, while the lower-investing sex competes harder for access.

How do we know Trivers's law is real biology and NOT Victorian human stereotyping? Because **Trivers made a bold falsifiable prediction — SEX-ROLE REVERSAL**. Find species where **MALES invest more parental energy than females** — like **male-brooding pipefish, wattled jacana shorebirds, or giant nutrient-gift Mormon crickets** — and **MALES instantly become the picky, choosy sex while FEMALES grow larger, brighter, and fight over males**.

And unlike penguins or deer, **human fathers ALSO frequently invest decades of biparental care** — which is why Trivers predicted **BOTH human men and women** exercise high selectivity when seeking **long-term committed partners**.

In **1974 (SRC2)**, Trivers dropped his third bombshell — **Parent-Offspring Conflict**: a mother shares **50% of her genes equally** with Current Child AND Future Sibling (wanting to wean when Benefit/Cost drops to **1:1**), whereas Current Child shares **100% with itself** vs only **50% with a full sibling** (pushing to keep nursing until Benefit/Cost drops to **1:2**) — explaining universal toddler weaning tantrums and sibling rivalry.

Crucial modern synthesis (**Sarah Blaffer Hrdy; Eagly & Wood biosocial critique**): (1) Hrdy corrected early narrow readings that painted females as 'passive,' showing active female agency across primates; and (2) cross-nationally, as **modern societies increase women's economic and political equality**, human sex differences in mate-resource preferences **shrink substantially**, proving evolved dispositions flex dynamically with culture.

wow_facts.fact: Want ironclad proof that choosiness follows **who carries the baby** rather than XY chromosomes? Look at **brood-pouch pipefish and jacana birds**: the **FATHERS** carry and nourish the eggs for weeks — and instantly **the dads become picky choosers while females sport showy ornaments and compete for dads**.
wow_facts.why_surprising: Nature flipped the parenting bill and courtship flipped 180 degrees right on cue.

wow_facts.fact: Ever wondered why **weaning tantrums and 'that's NOT FAIR!' sibling battles** happen in puppies, monkeys, pelicans, AND human kitchens? Trivers (1974, SRC2) solved it with one fraction: **Mom is 50% related to both kids; You are 100% related to Yourself and 50% to your sibling**.
wow_facts.why_surprising: A two-line genetic fraction explained every toddler bedtime negotiation on Earth.

wow_facts.fact: Why do humans feel warm **gratitude** toward helpers, burning **indignation** at freeloaders, and **guilt** when caught cutting corners? Trivers (1971, SRC1) showed moral emotions are the **accounting ledger of Reciprocal Altruism**.
wow_facts.why_surprising: Emotions evolved as trust-enforcement software long before written contracts.

misconceptions.myth: Trivers claimed males are biologically hardwired to be promiscuous and uninvolved in every species and every human society.
misconceptions.truth: The exact opposite. Trivers proved behavior tracks **parental investment, not maleness** — predicting male choosiness in male-brooding species AND mutual pickiness in high-investing **human biparental long-term pairs**.

misconceptions.myth: Evolutionary biology means 'genes are destiny' and modern culture or gender equality changes nothing.
misconceptions.truth: Cross-cultural data (Eagly & Wood) show human partner preferences respond strongly to **local ecology, contraception, and economic equality** — evolved psychology is context-sensitive, never rigid.

misconceptions.myth: Parent-child conflict means either the parent or the toddler is 'doing something wrong'.
misconceptions.truth: Trivers (1974, SRC2) showed mild parent-offspring tension (100% self vs 50% sibling relatedness) is a completely normal feature of every caring mammal and bird family.

everyday_hooks: Laughing in relief when your two kids argue over attention at dinner — realizing Trivers proved **100%-vs-50% genetic math** makes mild sibling tugs-of-war universal across nature.
Noticing why **gratitude** and **unfairness outrage** fire so fast in office group projects (Trivers's 1971 Reciprocal Altruism ledger at work!).
Seeing why **both** partners in a committed long-term human relationship become equally selective when both plan to invest decades together.
